Karnaphuli Yarn Traders
QUOTATION
Quotation no. QT-2026-903 Date 2026-10-23
To Aamar Garments Ltd (fictional) Reference PR-2026-114
Item Description Qty Unit Unit price (BDT) Amount (BDT)
C Polyester sewing thread, cone 800 cone 229.00 183,200.00
Subtotal 183,200.00
VAT 15% 27,480.00
Total 210,680.00
Supplier TIN: 103458033391 BIN: 000370341-0101
TERMS AND CONDITIONS
1. Payment. 15% advance payable with the purchase order. Balance within 40 days of delivery.
2. Delivery. Delivery within 20 days of PO.
3. Delay. Delay in delivery will attract a penalty of 0.5% of order value per week.
4. Validity. This quotation is valid for 30 days from the date above.
5. Quality. Goods are supplied as per the buyer's approved sample. Defective goods will be replaced at the
supplier's cost.
6. Disputes. Any dispute will first be settled by discussion; failing that, through arbitration in Dhaka.
For Karnaphuli Yarn Traders
Authorised signatory (fictional sample document)
